name: Runes of Battle
summary: You learn psychic powers from the Universal, Divination, Telekinesis, and Warlock power lists. You may learn Pyromancy only if the GM allows a destructive battle-seer interpretation. You cannot learn Malefic powers. The Aeldari Warlock level table lists your Minor, Standard, and Major powers known. You learn powers from your allowed lists as you gain levels.
